title: Karaoke Night on Friday 18 September
preheader: Free entry · karaoke from 8pm · huge song choice · solos, duets and groups welcome

image.alt: Karaoke Night singer using a microphone at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

data.headline: What are you singing first?
body: Start the weekend with a huge song choice, a welcoming crowd and plenty of support for every singer. Come for the microphone, come for the music or happily do both. Entry is free.

data.label: Your night, your song.
data.body: Solo singers · Duets · Groups · First-timers · Confident performers · Happy listeners

rows.label: Songs
rows.value: Request your choice through the host on the night

data.heading: A Friday night built for singing
body: Peter will keep the queue moving and the room cheering. Pick a favourite, bring a duet partner or gather the whole group for a chorus. Families are welcome too.
Make a full evening of it with dinner before the singing starts. Our full dinner menu is available from 4pm to 9pm.

data.body: Book everyone coming so we can prepare the communal seating, then start choosing your first song.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
